args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List

Based on Emma Johnson's Hawaii Vacation Plans (June 10-20, 2024)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days)
- Beach cover-ups and sarongs
- Casual t-shirts and shorts
- Light pants or jeans
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Rain jacket or light windbreaker (for potential showers)
- One nice outfit for dinner/luaus
- Underwear and socks

TOILETRIES & HEALTH:
- Sunscreen (SPF 30+)
- After-sun lotion
- Insect repellent
- Prescription medications
- First aid kit
- Hand sanitizer
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Makeup and toiletries

ELECTRONICS & ACCESSORIES:
- Camera and extra batteries
- Phone and charger
- Portable power bank
- Sunglasses
- Hat or cap
- Waterproof phone case
- Earbuds or headphones

TRAVEL DOCUMENTS:
- Passport
- Driver's license
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservations
- Car rental documents (if applicable)
- Cash and credit cards
- Emergency contact information

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- Hiking boots or sturdy shoes
- Hiking poles (for Diamond Head hike)
- Snorkeling gear (mask, snorkel, fins) - or rental information
- Kayak rental information
- Beach towel
- Beach bag
- Water bottle

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Travel pillow
- Eye mask and earplugs
- Small backpack for day trips
- Laundry detergent (travel size)
- Ziplock bags
- Travel umbrella
- Hand sanitizer wipes

NOTES:
- Check weather forecast closer to travel date
- Consider bringing a reusable water bottle
- Pack light layers for air conditioning
- Keep valuables secure at the beach
